Aug 18, 2016

I'm going to bite her.

It's a foregone conclusion. In a little less than an hour I'm going to bite her.

I lost her mother when the madness started. If only I'd been a bit braver I could have changed that.

I've always felt cursed. Even before the world went to shit I was always on the periphery. Never quite fitting in. I played the game well enough that no one noticed, even my wife. The overnight "business trips", the "guy's" nights out. It was hard but I did it. I always felt guilty but I did what I had to do....

Now here we are. I know others have survived but I'm fairly sure none of them are close.

So it's just me and my daughter. I wanted her to grow up with a normal childhood. A place to fit in, a world without monsters. But it wasn't true. There have always been monsters. But who defines what a monster is?

It's getting darker. I've been thinking about her mother. I should have been honest with her but I was afraid I'd lose her. I had the chance, hell I had plenty of chances but never took them. Damn it! I should have. Maybe she'd still be here. That's the problem, the guilt. All my life, (double lives really) I've lived in the shadows. She probably would have left me and taken Casandra with her....

I'm going to bite her. I can feel it coming on now just a few more minutes, maybe a half an hour.

I can't explain it to her she's only seven. She knows monsters are real now. How would I tell her?

"Daddy's going to change. you need to hide."???

It wouldn't do any good, I'm sure I'd find her - the flutter of her heartbeat or maybe her smell would give her away. I'm not going to lose her like I did her mother. No I'm going to bite her and when it's done we'll be together.

I wonder what it's like to be a zombie. Do they have any thoughts at all, or is it simply a mad all-consuming hunger?

I've kept her alive the last two weeks, sheltering her the best I could. The things I had to do. The "games" of hide and seek, off in a closet or under a bed while I took care of the threats. It's almost over. No more guilt. I'll be free.

I'm going to bite her. It's close now. I can feel my humanity slipping, the pain is starting and I'm getting hungry.

What a beautiful last night. I see the first stars and the moon is rising. She's sitting just a couple feet away, I told her tonight was a special night the last night of the monsters and she should enjoy seeing the moon rise.

I'm putting this down in the few minutes I have left. Don't feel guilty. It's the only way and you know it. We'll be together forever after this. We won't have to hide and I'm pretty sure there won't be anyone left to care what we are. It's strange - what I always took as a curse may now be a blessing in disguise.

I'm going to bite her. I'm hoping I'll have enough restraint that her smell will stop me from making a mess of things. It should, at least that's what I heard growing up. You bite the ones you love, but eat the others....

When she gets older just remember this night. You'll have to explain it, although she'll be growing up in a new world.

She won't have to hide what she is, a hunter. I'm sure she'll want to know why not her mom? I'll have to try and tell her what it was like before the madness happened. Hunted and hunting, hiding what and who I was.

It's not so bad now, all that worry is gone and I can barely hold the pencil. The pain is getting really bad, Just a few last words before the end of the old world.

I'm going to bite her because I love her. It's the only way. I couldn't go on without her.

I just hope she can forgive me for making her a werewolf.
